_comment: Copy to api.config.json (gitignored) and point it at the VR Framework package inside your Unity project - the folder that holds Runtime/ and Editor/. Relative paths are resolved from the repo root.
_comment_unityProject: Optional. Defaults to the folder above Assets/, which is where Unity puts the generated .csproj files.
_comment_sourceUrlTemplate: Optional. Adds 'view source' links. Placeholders: {repo} {branch} {path} {line}. Drop the key to omit the links (e.g. when the repo is private and the docs are public).
_comment_exclude: Optional. Path segments inside the package whose assemblies are never documented.
